notes: Author a C scorer from a strict spec and compile it to a native ELF at /app/bin/infer with a fixed, literal two-argument order (weights path then image path). Covers argument-order/argument-count handling, strict PGM P2 and comment-tolerant weights parsing, 4x4 block integer scoring, and recompile independence (verifier rebuilds the shipped source and re-runs every hidden case, including malformed-input exits and a swapped-argument probe). Rubric total 11 -> medium; hidden cases generalize across sizes, comment placement, >16 weights, zero scores, and malformed files.
